placements.overview:
Established in 1985, ISM - Institute of Science and Management is located in Ranchi, Jharkhand. The institute offers courses like MBA/PGDM, B.Sc., BCA, BBA and UG Diploma. These courses are offered in Full Time mode. A total of 7 courses offered by the Institute are available across streams such as Business & Management Studies, IT & Software and Hospitality & Travel. The institute has all the necessary facilities to the students.

ISM - Institute of Science and Management offers a wide range of programmes to students at the UG and PG levels. The college is mainly concerned with streams such as Business & Management Studies, IT & Software and Hospitality & Travel. At the UG level, the college offers courses such as B.Sc., BCA and BBA. At the PG level, the college offers courses such as MBA/PGDM. ISM - Institute of Science and Management courses are offered to students in Full Time mode. Further, the fees structure for ISM - Institute of Science and Management courses stands around INR 3,35,000.

reviews.review_text: The college has no infrastructure, just a 5 floor building that looks like apartments. There is no campus. I think the kindergarten infrastructure is much better than this college. There is no Wi-Fi, only a small library, bad cell classrooms, and some labs with no equipment.

reviews.review_heading: Small classrooms, no proper facilities, and a poor hostel.
reviews.review_text: In my college classrooms were small and there was no proper Wi-Fi connection. We did not have a dedicated library, and only a few computers were available which was not sufficient for students. Hostel facilities were very basic with small rooms and the mess food was repetitive and often not of good quality.

reviews.review_heading: SBIHM Jatragachi campus is a very good college for me. I think it will also be good for you.
reviews.review_text: From the library, we can get every type of book we want. Hostel facilities are provided at Rs. 7000 per month.

reviews.review_heading: Subhash Bose Institute of Hotel Management & Hospital .

reviews.review_heading: Life at SBIHM is very interesting.
reviews.review_text: The food production lab is completely equipped with imported equipment, and it has a seating capacity of 40 students. There is a well-equipped training restaurant. Laundry facilities are available for every student in the training period for guest room management. The canteen facility is awesome.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Computer Science - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: It is a really good college.

content.Placements: As this is mainly a B.Sc. And M.Sc. Degree college, proper campus placements are not available. However, some placement support is provided for Computer Science students. The college and the teachers are very good and helpful. Students can easily get internship opportunities from here. The expected salary package is around 3.5 to 5 LPA, even though there is no official placement system.
content.Infrastructure: Students can easily use the library. There are several labs where students can do practical work. The campus has a Wi-Fi facility. Digital boards are used in classrooms. There is a gym for students who like fitness. The canteen is very good. There is no hostel, so students stay in nearby messes or rented rooms.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with the facility, however placements are very rare. The infrastructure is not lacking.

content.Placements: I have yet to pass out, but I can provide some details on alumni. From the CS department, a couple of guys got placed in TCS. The Maths department did not see many placements, mostly went for off campus or higher studies. Similar to the department of Physics, mostly off campus and higher studies.
content.Infrastructure: I do not have any use for a hostel, nor does my college provide hostels. I live not too far away, so traveling daily is practical. As for the college infrastructure, we have enough computers, good Wi-Fi, and good enough classrooms/lecture halls. Most of the apparatus is not digital in the Physics lab.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. (Hons.) in English - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: It is a good and worthy college for both personal and academic growth.

content.Placements: Placements are average and mainly depend on students’ individual skills, performance, and internships. Around 50–60% of students secure placements and internships. The highest package offered is around 6–7 LPA, while the average is 3–4 LPA. Recruiting companies are popular, but as I am not aware of the companies, I cannot specify them.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is spacious, clean, and aesthetically pleasing. It has a pond-like area where students can get some fresh air and relax. Classrooms are good, but a few classrooms still need some improvement. Library is very nice. It is well-stocked with all types of books and journals. Free Wi-Fi is available, as well as a canteen.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Chemistry - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Overall faculty is awesome. Teachers have great experience in teaching.

content.Placements: There were no proper placements because its not an engineering college, but there were opportunities, sometimes companies visit for recruitment. There were notices on the college website from which you can see about the placement cell in our college and companies visiting for students with a Science background to hire if students were interested.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure was overall good. Wi-Fi was available in every building. Students can use them. Wi-Fi speed was good. Library was also top class, you could borrow books from there for free, but for a limited period of time you could also renew them. We were in Chemistry department, so chemicals were plentiful, which helped in learning practicals very well. Labs were also good.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: College is not the place of study, it's about bonding, understanding, etc.

content.Placements: Normal placement companies like TCS. Chances are low, but placement is guaranteed. The teachers always help students with placement issues. Suggest how to be good at that. They will figure it out together for placement problems because they understand.
content.Infrastructure: Clean environment. Good Wi-Fi connection. Canteen food quality is average. Classrooms are well-maintained. Secure and smoke-free campus.
content.Faculty: Teaching quality is too good. The teachers always stand for students. Teachers are friendly with students. Even teachers play with students, like cricket, chess, etc. There is a yoga room for all of us, and it is well-maintained. It is clean also. I like my college.

individual_reviews.course: Discontinue (Oct 2025) - Bachelor of Management Studies (BMS) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Overall, my experience of college life here is amazing, and I have learned many things.

content.Placements: Around 40% of students from my batch appeared for placement, and around 35% of students got placed. 2.5 LPA to 4 LPA is the package offered. Recruiting companies are Mahindra, Byju's, banks, ITC, etc. Internships are provided for the same university as well as other companies like Dalmia Cement Sudha, etc. Roles offered are business development, admission counseling, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms have facilities provided that were very good, like whiteboards, projectors, an easily accessible library, and computer labs are also provided for several subjects, and extra computer skills are also taught. The quality of food in the hostel mess is pretty hygienic, and good medical facilities are also provided for those in need.

individual_reviews.course: Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharma.D.) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Narayan Institute of Pharmacy: Absolutely satisfied with the overall experience, excellent.

content.Placements: The college has top faculty members, the best behavior, and a cooperative culture. There is a maximum placement rate in pharmacy companies. Ex-students also qualify for GPAT. College placement in a maximum company. Enjoying my course 100% satisfied. Free of ragging, the special disciplinary committee has zero tolerance for ragging and is overall excellent.
content.Infrastructure: Well-equipped labs are separate. Computer labs. No rush in classes. Wi-fi and CCTV camera-equipped classes. Badminton and basketball courts are available. Regular maintenance of the projector is available in class. Good condition sitting facility. Hostel rooms are regularly cleaned. Hygienic mess. Overall, the infrastructure is awesome.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor in Physiotherapy (BPT) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: A college with affordable fees and good infrastructure, having trained professionals for teaching.

content.Placements: The placement opportunities for the Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) course at this college are moderately satisfactory, with room for improvement. Most students secure jobs through clinical internships or referrals during their final year, rather than through formal placement drives. The average starting salary ranges between 15,000 to 25,000 per month, depending on the location and organisation. A few students may receive offers from private clinics or hospitals.
content.Infrastructure: The BPT course infrastructure in the college is well-developed. Classrooms are spacious and equipped with AV aids. Labs are modern, especially for anatomy and exercise therapy. The library is resourceful. Clinical training facilities and tie-ups with hospitals are strong.

individual_reviews.course: Discontinue (Oct 2025) - B.Sc. in Agriculture - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: In private colleges in Bihar, GNSU is the best university.

content.Placements: The placement cell is good and helpful. They also train students and make them ready to present themselves to companies. The placement cell faculty members are also too good and supportive. But they generally attract private companies or organizations. The package is average, but according to students' capabilities, they try to give their 100 percent. The placement ratio is also good. Last year, they placed about 70 students out of 100.
content.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure is good. Labs and the library are also student-friendly. Classrooms are comfortable and attached to technology. The hostel is also good, with facilities like electricity, water, and a lift available 24/7. The mess is also good and hygienic, but the quality of food in taste is not valuable.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Offers good infrastructure and experiences in terms of education and events as well.

content.Placements: About 30-40% percent students are placed with the average package of 3 LPA. The top roles offered by companies are Python Developer, Front Developer, and Full Stack Developer. I really have no idea about the least package, but recently one of my seniors got placed in a company with an annual package of 12 LPA. Recently, I have an internship from a company named Codexintern and worked there as a Python intern.
content.Infrastructure: It provides good facilities to students, such as well-maintained hostels, timely fooding service, etc. In terms of studies and all, it is good as well. It provides free Wi-Fi for IT students, computer lab to use anytime, etc. It also has a well-developed and hygienic environment and well-developed medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, my experience of college life here is amazing, and I have learned many things.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms have facilities provided that were very good, like whiteboards, projectors, an easily accessible library, and computer labs are also provided for several subjects, and extra computer skills are also taught. The quality of food in the hostel mess is pretty hygienic, and good medical facilities are also provided for those in need.

reviews.review_heading: Narayan Institute of Pharmacy: Absolutely satisfied with the overall experience, excellent.
reviews.review_text: Well-equipped labs are separate. Computer labs. No rush in classes. Wi-fi and CCTV camera-equipped classes. Badminton and basketball courts are available. Regular maintenance of the projector is available in class. Good condition sitting facility. Hostel rooms are regularly cleaned. Hygienic mess. Overall, the infrastructure is awesome.

reviews.review_heading: A college with affordable fees and good infrastructure, having trained professionals for teaching.
reviews.review_text: The BPT course infrastructure in the college is well-developed. Classrooms are spacious and equipped with AV aids. Labs are modern, especially for anatomy and exercise therapy. The library is resourceful. Clinical training facilities and tie-ups with hospitals are strong.

reviews.review_heading: In private colleges in Bihar, GNSU is the best university.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is good. Labs and the library are also student-friendly. Classrooms are comfortable and attached to technology. The hostel is also good, with facilities like electricity, water, and a lift available 24/7. The mess is also good and hygienic, but the quality of food in taste is not valuable.

reviews.review_heading: Offers good infrastructure and experiences in terms of education and events as well.
reviews.review_text: It provides good facilities to students, such as well-maintained hostels, timely fooding service, etc. In terms of studies and all, it is good as well. It provides free Wi-Fi for IT students, computer lab to use anytime, etc. It also has a well-developed and hygienic environment and well-developed medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: You won't love the lecture.
reviews.review_text:
The facilities and infrastructure available in my college include the library, labs, classrooms, and online tools to teach students.
The quality of facilities in my hostel is very bad because the owner of the hostel provides bad food and rudely talks to students.

reviews.review_heading: The university which is the future of Bihar.
reviews.review_text:
Yes, labs are available in very good quality. Every piece of equipment is available for the experiments. Each piece of equipment is available for each student. 
Sometimes foods are very bad in taste but sometimes they make good quality food. Staff and the warden of the hostel are very friendly .

reviews.review_heading: It is currently an underrated college, but it has great capabilities to expand.
reviews.review_text: The hostels are seriously good. I can totally claim that the mess of the hostel offers the best food compared to others. The medical facilities are also good; the university has its own hospital with a good infrastructure, and manpower and technology availability are also satisfactory.

reviews.review_heading: Good college and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: In our hostel, I stayed in a 4-seater room, which has many facilities like 24-hour electricity and fresh mineral water. The meal quality is moderately good. The registration process in hostels is that we have to fill out the hostel form and contact the hostel in charge.

reviews.review_heading: Even after the Agriculture course started in May 2019, the facilities here are quite good.
reviews.review_text: All facilities are available. The infrastructure is very good. Almost 4-5 hostel messes and 2-3 canteens are available in our university. Many types of facilities are available in this university. The university also has its own hospital, which is a very good thing. If you get sick, you don't have to go anywhere else.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Gopal Narayan Singh University.
reviews.review_text: There are so many courses available in my university. It consists of classrooms and a library. Good facilities are available in my hostel, and they maintain proper hygiene. They provide food at low prices because poor students also take admission in this college. Medical facilities and sports are also available.

reviews.review_heading: All facilities are good but some teacher's behaviour are very rude.
reviews.review_text: All facilities are available for study like- skill lab, foundation of nursing lab, community health nursing lab, computer lab, common room for boys and girls, library, visitor room, sick room. Ten lecturer rooms for teaching. The university's own hospital is available for proper training.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Gopal Narayan Singh University.
reviews.review_text: A moot court and a computer lab are available. We have a mess and a library. The quality of the food is good. Digital classrooms are available. The university provides free medical checkups for the students who reside on the hostel campus.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Gopal Narayan Singh University.
reviews.review_text: Computer labs and a library are available. There is one moot court area. A playground for various activities, including NCC. Everything is good. Medical facilities are available. The quality of the food is good, but the taste is average, especially on Monday and Tuesday.

reviews.review_heading: It's a good college, but its management needs to improve more.
reviews.review_text: Labs are available to do each type of experiment. Classrooms are well maintained. They have projectors. It has a well-stocked library with all types of books related to the course. The hostel rooms are good. The food changes with the seasons.

reviews.review_heading: Somewhat satisfied, but they collect a lot of money.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good, but sometimes there is a power cut. The software required is not installed sometimes in the lab, which leads to a delay in completing the syllabus, and we may lag behind others. There are times when people staying in a hostel don't get proper food.

reviews.review_heading: I really feel so proud and very happy to get educated here.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and facilities are absolutely awesome in our college. You can get more advanced chance of getting sports. The hostel facilities are also the best. I have never seen before, as they offer so many advantages, and we have so many ways to improve.

reviews.review_heading: I'm dissatisfied with my overall experience. Bad placements, bad faculty, and staff.
reviews.review_text: The only thing I loved and kept in my memories only is the hostel because it is a nice experience for me. It doesn't feel like a hostel. We have many entertainments and a couple of memories.

reviews.review_heading: I am so much admired and satisfied with this college.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is so attractive and carries immense pleasure in it. It's like I liked it at first site. Classrooms are wide and have all the facilities in it with good ventilation. When it comes to our canteen they maintain a lot of hygiene and the food provided over here is tasty and yummy.

reviews.review_heading: I am so much satisfied with this college.
reviews.review_text: When it comes to college infrastructure it is so good. I was attracted at first and that made me stay more and more. Our college has well-developed classrooms with all the facilities like Wi-Fi, projector, and smart boards. Our hostel food is tasty.

reviews.review_heading: I am so much satisfied and feel happy with this college.
reviews.review_text: When it comes to college infrastructure it is so good. I was attracted at first and that made me stay more and more. Our college has well-developed classrooms with all the facilities like Wi-Fi, projector, and smart boards. Our hostel food is so hygienic and tasty that we feel like going and eating again and again.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members motivate us, infrastructure is good with a peaceful and pleasant environment.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is one of the main reasons for joining this college. There is a saying 'A coin has two faces' the same way our college has both negative and positive views. The hostel is not very good and the food provided by them is good. Classrooms are not so much facilitated still we expect them to improve the facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the faculty and good placements in 2024.
reviews.review_text: ​Infrastructure is overall good, with spacious classrooms, a business lab, a library, a computer lab, and a science lab. The hostels are well-maintained, and there is a very big playground. Washrooms are well-maintained, with all the things needed in an emergency. The canteen is hygienic with spacious seating.

reviews.review_heading: I'm satisfied with paid money for having a degree.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very good and well-maintained. Wi-Fi facility is provided but password is not provided for every student. Library is available in our college. All books and daily newspapers are available. Hostel is provided only for boys on campus. The quality of food is very good.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfaction for studies, but no good placement.
reviews.review_text: As I took B.Sc. in Maths and Computer Science, my course is good for studies. Coming to the hostel, there is no hostel for girls, but for boys, we have a hostel inside the college. In our college, there are three canteens available, and the food is good and also worth the amount.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure but not value for money.
reviews.review_text: Library is good with some interesting books and classrooms are equipped with good projectors and are clean. Canteen food is not that good compared to other colleges but it is okay. Hostel rooms are also good and clean which helps students to not get sick and miss their home.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is very good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good. Our college provides us with all facilities. Our campus is Wi-Fi enabled. Labs and classrooms are good. The food served in the mess is good. The hostel is good.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is good and affordable to pursue studies.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good. Our campus is huge and has a clean environment for studying. Our college rules and regulations are strict. The hostel is not up to the mark. The hostel facilities are average. The food served at the hostel is average. Our college gives much importance to sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with this college because it has a huge campus.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides many facilities like labs, Wi-Fi, playgrounds, an e-library, restrooms, smart boards, good water facilities, a garden, etc. The food served in the canteen is good and provides a variety of food items.

reviews.review_heading: Review of St. Francis De Sales College.
reviews.review_text: There were 2 labs with sufficient computers. Canteen was hygienic and the food was good. There is no Wi-Fi. Library is very spacious with all kind of books. Digital library is available. Xerox is available in the library.

individual_reviews.title: Good college with helpful faculty, placements, and modern facilities.

admission_process.title: Annamacharya University (Formerly AITS, Rajampet) Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Annamacharya University (Formerly known as AITS Rajampet) admissions 2025 are offered to various courses at UG and PG levels in the stream of Engineering, Management, Science, Computer Applications and Humanities. The offered courses areBTech, MTech, MBA, BSc, BSc (Hons) Agriculture, MSc, MCA, etc.

Annamacharya University (AITS Rajampet) admissions are completely entrance-based. The university accepts scores of various state-level entrance exams for admission to respective courses such asEAPCET, ICET, PGCET, etc. However,Annamacharya University (AITS Rajampet)also conductsAnnamacharya University Entrance Test (AUET)for the selection of candidates for a few courses, followed by a PI round. Moreover, applications forFormerly known as Annamacharya Institute of Technology and Sciences, Rajampetuniversity admission are submitted on the official website of the respective exams. The university also offers scholarships to students of UG & PG courses. Candidates can avail of the scholarships by qualifying for AUET. More details aroundAnnamacharya University (AITS Rajampet) admission 2025are elaborated in the article below.

Annamacharya University courses are offered across multiple specialisation. The university offers primary weightage to the past academics of applicants. The selection process includes various parameters such as fulfilling the minimum eligibility criteria, qualifying for entrance exams and other selection rounds. Check below the course-wise eligibility and selection criteria for Annamacharya University course admission 2025:
Know more aboutAnnamacharya University courses

Admissions at Annamacharya University (Formerly known as AITS Rajampet) are completely entrance-based. The admission process begins by filling an online application form and proceeds with selection rounds and eventually ends with the counselling process. Check below the detailed steps for Annamacharya University admission process 2025:
Step 1: Application Process

Candidates seeking to apply for admission at Annamacharya University must apply for the entrance exams of the respective courses they are applying for. Aspirants can fill the online application form for AUET on the university's official website. However, for the remaining courses, candidates must apply on the official website of the respective entrance exams.
Step 2: Selection Rounds

After a successful online registration process, candidates must appear for the respective entrance exams accepted for admission to courses. The university shortlists students based on their past academic records and scores obtained in the respective state-level entrance exams. For admission to courses such as BSc, MSc, etc., candidates are offered admission through the university-levelAUET exam. For other courses such as BTech, MTech, MBA and MCA, candidates are shortlisted based onEAPCET, PGECET and ICET entrance exams. Further, candidates shortlisted via AUET scores are also called for aPI roundat Annamacharya University (AITS Rajampet).
Step 3: Counselling & Final Admission

At last, the selected candidates must appear for the counselling process. The final seat allotment is done through the counselling round. Candidates must pay a certain fee to confirm their seat at the university.

reviews.review_heading: It is a better college for M.A. economics in Kerala.
reviews.review_text: St. Albert's College has a better infrastructure than other colleges. The college has a big library, auditorium, and computer-based labs. The college has a playground, and every year it arranges a tournament. The college canteen is good. The college infrastructure is well-maintained.

reviews.review_heading: The college is wonderful with amazing teachers and supportive staff.
reviews.review_text: St. Albert's College has very good infrastructure facilities. It also has various infrastructures like computer labs, chemistry lab, library, auditorium, open-air auditorium, open-air gym, cafe, and college canteen. All the infrastructure facilities provided by the college are well maintained.

reviews.review_heading: Review of St. Albert's College.
reviews.review_text: They provide practicals in each sem. The hostel was in college only for boys. Sometimes the Wi-Fi didn't work, and the library was good for all students. On Thursday, they provide egg biriyani and chicken biriyani on Friday in the canteen, and it will be good food at that college.

reviews.review_heading: Best college for Grinders.
reviews.review_text: The college has good infrastructure with digital classrooms, computer labs, well stocked library, etc. Good food is provided by the canteen, and medical help is available. The campus also has a sports campus for both indoor and outdoor games to empower students in sports as well as academics.

reviews.review_heading: Above average college for M.Com in Finance.
reviews.review_text: The college's infrastructure is good. The campus is kept up nicely and is clean. The site has labs, a library, classrooms, a canteen, dorms, and restrooms. Additionally, there are dustbins for paper, food, and plastic garbage. In addition, our college has a restaurant and a stationery store. The food at the canteen is very good. Smart boards are available in every classroom, which facilitates learning. Our college has a large number of halls with clean restrooms.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, best college for M.Com. in finance course.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure was good. So, they were equipped with many amenities like high-speed Wi-Fi, and labs equipped with almost all kinds of equipment. Classrooms were well-equipped and fully air-conditioned. Library was totally disciplined. Mess facilities were not very good, but it was normal. But in terms of sports and cultural activities, the hostel helps us grow.

reviews.review_heading: Great college for a great amount that you spend.
reviews.review_text: Our department has so much good infrastructure. The college has Wi-Fi, but I don't know if all the students can use it. Classrooms are well developed with great smart TVs and everything to help us learn better. The college has a big library for all the students and teachers, which offers a wide variety of books and other things that we need. Now let's talk about the hostel. The hostel quality is so good that my friends who stay there said they're happy. Great food and great rooms.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the best college for M.Com. in the finance course.
reviews.review_text: The college facilities are good. Labs, Wi-Fi, smart classrooms, good library, and everything is there. Sports facilities are offered in the college as well as in the hostels. Hostel accommodation is adequate with two rooms. The violence is manipulative. I didn't encountered any issues with the infrastructure in my station.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review about my college.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facility is not so good as compared to other colleges since it is a Government college, but they are continuously improving the quality of lifestyle which is being imparted to students in hostels. The course curriculum is a bit outdated, but professors bring lots of new topics for discussion. Pedagogy is also a bit outdated, considering the fact that lots of other MBA institutes have innovative styles of teaching. Some of the courses were offered in specific campuses, hence creating a lot...

reviews.review_heading: St Albert's College autonomous review for new students.
reviews.review_text: Our college was autonomous, which made our college infrastructure top-level compared with other colleges. To get autonomous, college management needed to be well-maintained. The infrastructure at time of NAAC visit. We had large canteen facilities for students and teachers, it's looking like a restaurant inside a college well-maintained and clean. Students had a separate cafeteria for buying snacks in the evening, which means students did not need to go outside of the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Overall good experience.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi connection is there. The library, labs and classrooms are well-equipped. The quality of the food available in the canteen and mess is pretty okay. Medical facilities are pretty good and well-equipped. Sports and games can be improved some more.

reviews.review_heading: Happy and satisfied with my experience in the college, good infrastructure and learning experience.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of classrooms and libraries is very good. Resourceful books are available in the library. There's a canteen and a cafe inside campus and the food quality is good; they maintain cleanliness. As a day scholar, I'm not much aware of hostel facilities; however, from what my friends have told me, they are satisfied with their experience.

reviews.review_heading: A review about St Alberts College, Ernakulam.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure was good. But St. Alberts College needs more open areas within the college. Most of the class implements a smart board and projector. The quality of food provided in the canteen is good. The college also provides both boys and girls hostels.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with the good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: I don't know about the hostel facility because I didn't stay in the hostel. Classrooms have digital TV and also good infrastructure. Lab facilities and canteen food are good. The sports ground is not near the college. Every Friday there is a cultural fest.

reviews.review_heading: St. Albert's College Autonomous .
reviews.review_text: The college provides the best courses at the best quality. Has a wide variety of courses. The classes have smart facilities and Wi-Fi, and the hostel also has good facilities and the best foods. The college provides every medical facility for emergency situations.

Bharath College of Science and Management offers placement assistance to the students. By attending training programmes hosted by the college, students can develop their skills and start their own business and become a successful entrepreneur. Nutrition and Dietetics deapartment arrange internship training in leading hospitals and hotels along with placement assistance. admission_process.title: SSVGI Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Shri Siddhi Vinayak Group of Institutions admission processinvolves multiple steps. Selection is based on both, merit and entrance exams. The process is mainly conducted online. The admission criteria for all undergraduate and postgraduate courses, except BTech and MBA, are merit-based. For BTech, the institute accepts entrance exam scores, and for MBA admission, candidates must have a valid CAT/ CMAT/ XAT/ MAT scorecard. Those interested can check out the completeSSVGI admission processexplained below:
1 - Check the Eligibility

Aspirants must first check the eligibility criteria of the course they wish to pursue. The official website of the institute has detailed admission criteria for each of the offered programmes. The basic gist is given in the section above for various SSVGI courses.
2 - Application
The college accepts both online and offline admissions. Online applications can be made by visiting the official website.
3 - Selection rounds

Candidates need to appear for the relevant entrance exam (if required) to get shortlisted for admission. The selection criteria for almost all courses are merit-based. For admission to courses, such as BTech, MBA/ PGDM, MTech, etc., scores secured in entrance tests are considered. Similarly, for admissions to other courses, students need to provide the merit secured in the last qualifying exam.
4 - Admission confirmation
Once the selection rounds are done, the shortlisted candidates are called for document verification. Aspirants need to pay theSSVGI feesto confirm their seat in the college.

individual_reviews.title: Institute with a difference.

content.Placements: Last fortnight of October or 1st fortnight of November, the administration will be in touch and convey you the exact dates. Companies come and conduct GDs, interviews, written tests, etc. There are 100% placements with their own interest. ICICI, Coramandal, Escort, Cms, Jeevika, Mahyco and Big Basket are the leading ones with highest package of 11 lakhs/annum(include health insurance) and the lowest of 4.5 lakhs/annum. 6.5 lakhs/annum is offered on an average with roles like credit managers, supply chain managers, management trainee, MDO, etc, Coming to summer internships, TCS, DOW Chemicals, Jeevika, Meghmani and Sulphur Mills are the leading ones with the highest stipend of 25000, the lowest of 12000 and the average of 15000.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Agri-Business Management - Batch of 2016
individual_reviews.title: NIAM is the only premier institute in entire South-East Asia for agricultural marketing.

content.Placements: I got placed in Fullerton India Credit Company Limited as a cluster manager. It is a Singapore-based NBFC established in 2007 in India. There are 100% placements every year in top agri-business as well as finance sector companies. The average package offered by companies is 6 lakhs and the highest and lowest packages are 10 lakhs and 4.5 lakhs respectively. Almost all the reputed agri-business companies visited the college. Every student got the internship as well as final placements. The internship students get an average stipend of 8,000 monthly.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Agri-Business Management - Batch of 2016
individual_reviews.title: Good environment to learn freely.

content.Placements: Placements were 100% till 2016, and the packages ranged from 9.5 lakhs to 6 lakhs. Reputed MNCs of input, banking and consultancy services companies came to our campus. Internships were compulsory in our course curriculum which were 100%, and the Stipend was from Rs.5,000 to Rs.30,000.

reviews_list.review_title: Satisfied with faculty members, infrastructure, and good facilities.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Our university is located in Kegav near Solapur. It is the best university in Solapur.

review_content.Placements: So, currently I am in my 3rd year of B.Tech in Computer Science. In our class, there are 20 students. The highest and the lowest package offered depends on skills of that particular person. If students have good skills and do some projects, they will get a placement with the highest package.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure of our course include Wi-Fi connection in labs and classrooms. Every student has their own individual PC. Facilities available in the hostel are Wi-Fi and lifts. There are AC and non-AC rooms. The food is also good.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: It has good infrastructure, campus life, and average faculty.

review_content.Infrastructure: Our college has good Wi-Fi, excellent labs with updated PCs, clean classrooms, and a well-stocked library. Hostel rooms are okay. The food in the mess is tasty but a bit costly. All the sports equipment is available, like football, cricket kits, table tennis, badminton, volleyball, etc.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor in Computer Applications (BCA) - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: I am thankful and satisfied.

They are currently in touch with Cisco, Infosys, and other companies, and like our seniors, many companies have come for placement purposes. They have taken aptitude tests and interviews of our seniors who are in their final year, and many have been selected.

review_summary.college_name: MIT Vishwaprayag University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Master of Computer Application (MCA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: The university offers good infrastructure and decent placements, with scope for self-growth.

content.Placements: I belong to the MCA course at MIT Vishwaprayag University. Around 60–70% of students get placed, with salary packages ranging from 3 LPA to 7–8 LPA depending on the company and role. The university provides placement support, but placements and internships mainly depend on individual skills, projects, and practical knowledge. Students who actively work on internships, certifications, and technical skills have better chances of securing good opportunities.
content.Infrastructure: MIT Vishwaprayag University has good infrastructure. It has campus-wide Wi-Fi, well-equipped computer labs, and smart classrooms. It supports effective learning. Hostel facilities are decent and comfortable for students. University also gives strong importance to sports, and regularly organizing events. It provides all the required equipment for respective sports, encouraging overall student development.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (AI & ML) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with faculty members, infrastructure, and good facilities.

content.Placements: In my course, there are 75 students. The highest package offered till now is of 2,00,000 may be. The recruitment companies are like Infosys, etc. 60% of students got internships, and others got package offers. I don't know about top roles offered in our course. But every student has its own talent based on which they get jobs.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of our college is very good, which means there are large classrooms. Computer labs are available whenever you want to use them. The hostel is not fully developed yet but its infrastructure is also good. Mess and canteen food are also best quality.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Our university is located in Kegav near Solapur. It is the best university in Solapur.

content.Placements: So, currently I am in my 3rd year of B.Tech in Computer Science. In our class, there are 20 students. The highest and the lowest package offered depends on skills of that particular person. If students have good skills and do some projects, they will get a placement with the highest package.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure of our course include Wi-Fi connection in labs and classrooms. Every student has their own individual PC. Facilities available in the hostel are Wi-Fi and lifts. There are AC and non-AC rooms. The food is also good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: It has good infrastructure, campus life, and average faculty.

content.Placements: For now, only the PG batches like MBA and MCA are placed. The highest package offered is 9 LPA, and the lowest package ranges from 3-4 LPA. The average package offered is 6 LPA. Various companies like TCS, Wipro, Cognizant, Amdocs, Precision, etc., hire students. Every student gets internships based on their skills.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has good Wi-Fi, excellent labs with updated PCs, clean classrooms, and a well-stocked library. Hostel rooms are okay. The food in the mess is tasty but a bit costly. All the sports equipment is available, like football, cricket kits, table tennis, badminton, volleyball, etc.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor in Computer Applications (BCA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: I am thankful and satisfied.

content.Placements: So now I am in the 3rd year after a semester gap. From the 3rd year, our professors are going to train us for placement. They are currently in touch with Cisco, Infosys, and other companies, and like our seniors, many companies have come for placement purposes. They have taken aptitude tests and interviews of our seniors who are in their final year, and many have been selected.
content.Infrastructure: In our university, it's 7 7-floor building which includes computer labs, individual computers for every student, electronic lab, physics lab, and huge library for all courses, not only course-related material, but also includes self-growing books, story books, and all. In hostel, there are 2 students in one room, which includes AC and non-AC facilities. Wi-Fi facility and lift are available.
